title: Read data attributes from the bound button
goal: combines event.currentTarget and dataset to read the current operation item.
summary: The two exhibition area buttons use the same processing function. The number is stored in the data-room-code of the button. The icon or text clicked on the button should all get the same number.
tasks: monitors each .room-button click and obtains the number through event.currentTarget.dataset.roomCode.
Set #selection to “Current area: ” followed by the selected area code.

example.note: data-item-id maps to dataset.itemId. currentTarget is the element the listener is attached to.

hint: event.target is sometimes a span within a button. When the listener is bound to a button, use currentTarget.
